name: Refine To-TRD Wayfinder clarification flow
description: Modify only the reusable SKILLS-depo/to-trd source package so optional Wayfinder-style clarification happens conversationally and user answers are translated into the TRD requirements baseline without embedding unresolved interview questions for downstream planning.
definition_of_done: The source skill uses the fast path when the user's intent is already clear and asks clarification questions only when a material ambiguity affects the requirements.
When clarification is needed, the source skill asks one material question at a time, uses each answer to choose any necessary follow-up, and never answers a human preference question for the user.

Newly created or updated TRDs capture clarified answers as sourced user intent, decisions, scope, requirements, assumptions, or acceptance criteria and do not persist unresolved clarification-question prompts.
Draft handling preserves known intent and unresolved scope truthfully without presenting the draft as implementation-ready or losing compatibility with existing TRDs.
SKILLS-depo/to-trd documentation, template, example, helper behavior, and focused regression tests are internally consistent and all relevant validation passes.
Only SKILLS-depo/to-trd and this new Task's governed ledger records change; TASK-20260902-FFF5E32B and .agents/skills/to-trd remain unchanged.
current_summary: The reusable SKILLS-depo/to-trd package is updated to version 1.1.0. Clarification questions stay in the conversation; material answers flow into sourced TRD intent, decisions, scope, requirements, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. New and updated TRDs cannot persist Open questions or question-form Not yet specified entries. Legacy TRDs remain readable, and focused verification passes.
